items.t: St. Lucie County sheriff's deputy arrested on DUI charge after off-duty crash
items.x: A St. Lucie County Sheriff’s Office deputy was arrested on DUI charges following a March traffic crash in Vero Beach that caused serious bodily injury.

items.t: St. Lucie County deputy accused of DUI in Vero Beach crash that injured woman and child
items.x: An off-duty St. Lucie County sheriff's deputy faces DUI charges after a March 1 crash in Vero Beach that seriously injured a woman and hospitalized her son.

items.t: 14,000 turtle nests: Decades of protection pay off in Indian River County

items.t: Rescue crews save stranded manatee from ditch in Indian River County
items.x: A manatee was rescued in Indian River County after being found stranded in a ditch, according to the Indian River County Sheriff's Office.

items.t: Heavy rain, coastal flooding and rough surf impact South Florida before conditions improve
items.x: A Coastal Flood Warning is active.

items.t: A ceasefire in a devastated Ukrainian city holds for its first 30 hours, officials say
items.x: A six-day ceasefire in a Russian-occupied city in southern Ukraine held for its first day and night, officials said Wednesday, but Moscow and Kyiv continued to batter each other elsewhere.

items.t: US cruise ship suspends global voyage in Asia due to fuel costs, passengers stranded
items.x: A U.S. cruise ship on an around-the-world voyage that touted its cabins as floating homes suspended its three-year voyage in Cambodia due to fuel costs, forcing hundreds of passengers to disembark.

items.t: Brewers relief pitcher breaks postseason record
items.x: Milwaukee Brewers left-hander Aaron Ashby broke Andrew Miller's record for scoreless innings by a reliever in one postseason with a 1-2-3 ninth in Game 4 of the World Series

items.t: Brewers player ties 98-year-old record set by Babe Ruth during World Series
items.x: Jackson Chourio's tenth hit during Game 4 of the World Series tied a record set 98 years ago.

items.t: Wrong-way crash shuts down Southbound US 1 near Treasure Coast Square Mall
items.x: Audi SUV involved in police pursuit collides with oncoming vehicle; no fatalities reported

items.t: Martin County commissioners approve one-year pause on large-scale data center applications
items.x: Martin County commissioners voted unanimously to enact a one-year moratorium on large-scale data center applications to allow time for environmental studies and the development of future regulations.

items.t: Funeral arrangements announced for St. Lucie County firefighter and paramedic Austin Hodge
items.x: Memorial services for St. Lucie County firefighter Austin Hodge, who died in his sleep at a firehouse, are scheduled for November 6 and 7.

items.t: Milwaukee Brewers look to sweep World Series with ties to South Florida
items.x: The Milwaukee Brewers, leading the World Series 3-0, could clinch the championship on Tuesday night, with connections to Palm Beach County through their manager and a pitcher.

items.t: Brightline strikes, kills pedestrian in Delray Beach Tuesday

items.t: King tides bring flooding to Flagler Drive in West Palm Beach
items.x: King tides caused flooding along Flagler Drive in downtown West Palm Beach, prompting officials to warn drivers to avoid flooded roads.

items.t: King tides flood Jupiter Island as Amendment 3 raises funding concerns
items.x: King tides in Jupiter are causing extreme flooding, highlighting concerns about the potential impact of Amendment 3 on flood protection funding.

items.t: Palm Beach County Fire Rescue firefighter arrested after alleged domestic disturbance
items.x: A Palm Beach County firefighter was arrested following an alleged domestic incident at the South Florida Fairgrounds.

items.t: Murray Middle School breaks ground on $33 million rebuild after Hurricane Milton damage
items.x: Murray Middle School in Stuart broke ground on a $33 million rebuild after Hurricane Milton damaged campus buildings and displaced programs.

items.t: Rays' 12th-inning rally stuns Brewers, forces Game 5
items.x: Jonny DeLuca and pinch-hitter Ben Williamson singled home runs in a stunning 12th-inning rally, and the Tampa Bay Rays staved off World Series elimination with a 4-3 win over the Milwaukee Brewers that forced Game 5.
